hero.title: ART
hero.subtitle: where dream and dusk converse
hero.description: Between dusk and dream, pigment becomes memory. My work lives at the edge of the real and the imagined — intimate, surreal gestures that examine life and its shadow. These canvases are invitations to feel, to question, and to sit with the quiet that follows.

brand.name: AMA Studio
brand.tagline: Art that listens. Each work invites a moment of reflection.

about.title: Painting as a language of presence and loss.
about.text: I make work where the pictorial and the poetic meet — a practice of surfaces that hold memory, uncanny intimacies, and quiet reckonings. My paintings trace thresholds: of life and its echo, of tenderness and decay.

gallery.title: GALLERY
gallery.intro: A collection of works capturing different periods and styles of my art.

cta.title: Explore More
cta.text: Discover the full gallery with over 50 original pieces.

exhibitions.title: SERIES
exhibitions.index_intro: Each exhibition is a chapter — spaces where color, light and introspection meet.
exhibitions.description: Series as atmospheric passages — from intimate, introspective portraits to abstract, dream-worn landscapes. These cycles are not mere images but quiet rituals: dialogues between color, breath, and the shadow of meaning.
exhibitions.cta_text: Step through the full exhibition — a sequence of fragments tracing how light, form and mortality converse. Each canvas is a node in a wider meditation on being and the traces we leave.
